text: A muscular male figure with fair skin stands in a dark, starry setting. He has short, wavy blonde hair and a strong jawline. His torso is bare except for a brown belt with gold accents and a matching necklace with a central medallion. He wears black loincloth-style bottoms. One hand grips a long red staff held diagonally across his shoulder; the other hangs by his side. His posture suggests readiness or alertness, eyes fixed forward.
